title: Community Article Cards, 30 October
intro: Your community article as it is live ("Updated: Oct 25 2026"), read by me sentence by sentence beside your published version, the way I read the hypnosis guide (not Sonnet).

I checked each thing I found against how its words got there. Points your edits of 20 October, your rulings or your answers took out stay out: they're your cuts. Snags in words you chose that a reader still gets stay as they are. What's left is 19 cards:

4 sentences a cut of 24 October left hanging (cuts I advised): each fix keeps the cut. 5 commas and slips. 7 suggestions for your own words. 1 fix to my words. 2 questions, where a sentence of yours can be read two ways: tell me which you meant.
The post is live, so nothing changes until you say. Once you've answered, I'll give you each approved change as the exact old and new words to change in Substack's editor.
Your answers save as you click. When you're done, click Copy my answers (or Save them as a file) and send them to me.
